notes.title: Selatria: Full Version is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1052040/Selatria/

Thank you for your support for the Selatria project!

notes.title: Selatria: Advent of the Dakk'rian Empire - Patch 1.90.1 Notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, here are the Patch 1.90.1 notes for Selatria: Advent of the Dakk'rian Empire.


[u][b]Patch Notes[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] The graphics for the Selactic Chameleon have been revamped to better tell the difference between the elementals changing.
[*]  A bug where the Cat Lady would suggest the party to go retrieve cats from areas outside of the first three chapters has been fixed.
[*]  A bug where Mage would get pushed back into another area in the Gauntlet Speed Trial has been fixed. 
[*]  A bug where part of the Heiveir dock could not be walked on has been fixed. 
[*]  A bug where the Sea Seeker Megalodon could not be affected by the Negate spell has been fixed. 
[*]  Various typos have been fixed and addressed. 
[*]  Various minor audio and visual glitches and errors have been addressed. 
[/list]

[u][b]Known Issues[/b][/u]

[list]
[*]Framerates may dip in busy areas or areas with heavy processing on the Steam Deck.
[/list]

notes.title: Selatria: Advent of the Dakk'rian Empire - Patch 1.90 Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27508286/73d445343cbcdc7d4428cad32f3d627fddc262bd.png[/img]

[u][b]Patch 1.90 Notes[/b][/u]

Hi everyone, here are the Patch 1.90 notes for Selatria: Advent of the Dakk'rian Empire.

[b]Please note that this is the final major patch for Selatria: Advent of the Dakk'rian Empire. [/b] Only bug fixes and minor support adjustments will be provided moving forward. This patch sets the foundation for players to be able to carry their save data forward to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1052040/Selatria/]Selatria: Full Version[/url] on release if they desire.

To report an issue, please leave a message on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/578890/discussions/]Steam Discussion Board[/url] or on [url=https://discord.com/invite/whimindie]our Whim Indie Discord[/url].

[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] Steam Cloud support has been enabled for Selatria: Advent of the Dakk'rian Empire. Cloud saving will now activate when the game has closed.

[*] Steam Deck support is now available.* 
** Please note performance in certain areas on the Steam Deck may vary. We apologize for the inconvenience.

[*] A new Steam Deck specific version has been designated. This differs slightly from the PC version:
 ** The player is unable to change the resolution or window size.
 ** A different audio format is used for music that is played in the game.

[*] The controls diagram shown at the beginning of the game and in the Options window has been revamped. The control diagram will now dynamically change depending on if the player is actively using a keyboard or if the player is actively using a gamepad.

[*] The sound menu has been revamped. Music, SFX, Voices, can now be toggled and muted in the Options window.

[*] The main menu in game has been modified. The area window is now truncated, and players can Quick Save directly from the main menu.

[*] A battle help window has been added that shows the controls in battle. This can be disabled in the Options. 

[*] The font has been changed. 

[*] Several bosses and enemy stats have been adjusted.

[*] Several graphics have been adjusted.

[*] Gobby's victory pose has been changed.

[*] The number of collectible cats have been changed to reflect the number of those found in Selatria: Full Version

[*] Various NPCs have been added.

[*] Various quality-of-life improvements have been added to menus and sequences.

[*] The credits sequence at the end of Chapter 3 has been revamped.
[/list]

[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*] Framerates may dip in busy areas or areas with heavy processing on the Steam Deck.

[*] Voices may occasionally be cut off mid-sentence dialogue on the Steam Deck.

[*] Credit timing is slightly off between the Design and Art Teams.
[/list]

notes.title: Selatria Alpha Testing Starts April 24th!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

If you haven't heard already, We are planning on opening Alpha testing for our game Selatria! We are looking for individuals experienced playing the first half of the game (Selatria: Advent of the Dakk'rian Empire) or new players who have never played it before but are interested in trying it out! Experienced Players will start in Chapter 4, our unreleased and new chapter to the story!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27508286/af3f086d73359f464a0da976c21c5b763a25927f.png[/img]

We plan on starting Alpha testing on April 24th, in which participants will be emailed information on how to test it out and asked for their honest opinion on what they think of the game so far! 

Our studio is in the works of releasing the second half of our fantasy RPG game "Selatria"! It's a love letter to older Final Fantasy Games back on the SNES. It follows Mage and Melanie's story, two academic students who suddenly find themselves forced to fight a grudge war.  Mage and Melanie embark on a journey to reclaim their hometown known as Avalia!

Alpha Testing for the game will begin on April 24th, so we have opened up the Alpha Testing sign-up google form for anybody that would be interested in playing the new sections of our game! You'll be one of the first individuals to try out our game!

Here is the link to the Sign-up form: https://forms.gle/7XC1NWcNemL6PqKU8 

We will really appreciate your help and feedback!

notes.title: Selatria: Patch 1.27 Notes
notes.notes:
We recently updated Selatria to Patch 1.27, that addressed some bugs reported previously. Your save data should be unaffected by these changes.

[b][Additions/Changes][/b]

*The player can now press any key or button to skip the splash screen and go straight to the title screen.

*A notification pop-up now appears and a new sound effect is heard when the Journal has been updated.

*Opening or using the journal will automatically navigate to the newest entry.

*New character and portrait graphics have been added.

*New graphics have been added to the menu, map name, and battle screens.

*The world map on the Overworld can now be opened and closed with the “Q” key.

*New graphics have been added to the world map.

*Quick Save functionality has been added. Quick Save can be accessed from the Options/Exit menu to quickly save at any time. Quick Save data will open on the Journal and will be deleted upon opening. It is recommended to still make use of the normal save gates for extended periods of play.

*New locations have been added to the Overworld.

*Shopkeeper is now guaranteed to appear in every scene regardless of player action or inaction.

*Victory poses have been added for each party member after battle.

*EXP earned after the battle is won is now shown using an animated fill bar.

*Passive skills showing the party member’s traits have been added to the bottom of their ability list.

*Special monsters have been moved from the Overworld to dungeon entrances.

*The different purification spells have been merged into one single “Purify” and “Cleanse” spells that will clear status effects for different party members. 

[b][Fixed Issues][/b]

*Certain instances where the incorrect music would play in dungeons and cutscenes have been addressed.

*Several key items are no longer marked as usable.

*Various spelling and grammar issues and inconsistencies have been addressed.

*Several cutscenes displaying incorrect graphics have been addressed.
